svg.title: CIVIC CROSS / HQ, TRANSIT AND LOGISTICS
svg.text: CIVIC CROSS / HQ, TRANSIT AND LOGISTICS
17 central-cross plots / HQ exception retained / plaza and public-space envelopes remain separate from finished buildings
CITY-LOCAL NW ORIGIN | +X EAST | +Z SOUTH | CIVIL Y0 = FUTURE WALKABLE SURFACE S
ALL BOUNDS INCLUSIVE / NO WORLD ANCHOR OR SURVEYED Y / CIVIL DESIGN, NOT GAME-TESTED
HQ is plot 05-05: X405..469, Z405..469, exactly 65 x 65. Do not replace
it with the generic 64-wide CSV hall. Civil paths stop at the
V04/ V05 and H04/ H05 frame the central row and column. Logistics,
research, transit and public spaces retain every existing purpose
Arrival/ portal placement remains a reserved HQ/ plaza design
decision. The PDIM save and actual portal point are not known; no
portal block or dimension ID is invented.
